newsitem.title: THAILAND: Christiani Nielsen first quarter loss up.
newsitem.headline: Christiani Nielsen first quarter loss up.

text.p: Construction contractor Christiani & Nielsen (Thai) Plc on Monday attributed a sharply higher consolidated net loss in the first quarter to the weak Thai economy and a sustained property sector slump.
Christiani said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand its quarterly loss rose to 231 million baht ($9.24 million) from 172 million a year ago.

It said construction contracting revenue during January/March amounted to 1.99 billion baht or 26 percent lower than projected as the bearish Thai economy reduced construction activities in both private and public sectors.

Christiani said delayed start-ups of new construction projects also trimmed its gross profit margin to 3.75 percent from a projected 10.29 percent. It said its marketing and operating costs reached 274 million baht during the quarter against earlier expectations of 156 million for the period.

The construction contractor said its failure to sell off its engineering unit, Intertec Contracting A/S, by end-1996 weighed on the company's overall performance as Intertec posted a 30 million baht loss during the first quarter.
It said Christiani also needed to set aside 200 million baht to cover Intertec's overall losses.
Christiani had eased 0.10 baht to 5.00 on the Thai stock exchange at mid-Monday morning.
